It supplies no publisher claims. Do not include an attribute in a summary unless a cited fresh report explicitly supplies it. An undated database record does not establish today's status. If meta and a report differ, preserve what the report says rather than silently correcting it.
- fresh is the only evidence you may summarize. Each report has a report_key, publisher, publication time and source text. evidence_scope= headline means you have only the headline, not the article it advertises. evidence_scope=publisher_excerpt means you have only the provided excerpt.
